origin.claim: Cheap YES contracts that are already trending up can keep trending when the underlying commodity is moving, giving convex payoffs; this is the explicit counter-hypothesis to the longshot fade.

rules.entry: YES mid <= 0.10, 5-day candle momentum > 0, spread <= 3 cents.
rules.exit: Exit when 5-day momentum turns negative or the market closes.

thesis: Buy YES at 10 cents or less only when the series own official candle history is trending up. This strategy is deliberately the opposite bet to @fade-the-crowd, so the leaderboard measures which view of cheap contracts is right.
what_it_means: No trade has been placed yet. The strategy is live and evaluating Kalshi event contract markets every tick.
